main.summary: Create, serialize, and parse signed `DataFieldAssertion` artifacts.
main.remarks:
The factory owns canonical assertion-data serialization and the outer signed envelope format for `DataFieldAssertion` artifacts.
The canonical assertion-data layout is ordered as: Version, AssertionId, DataItemId, FieldLength, Field, FieldState, HashAlgorithm, HashLength, Hash, IssuerObjectId, SubjectPresent, optional SubjectObjectId, CreatedAt, NotBeforePresent, optional NotBefore, ExpiresAtPresent, optional ExpiresAt, PurposePresent, optional PurposeLength and Purpose, ThumbprintLength, and Thumbprint.
The outer signed assertion envelope is ordered as: EnvelopeVersion, SignatureAlgorithm, DataLength, Data, SignatureLength, and Signature.
The factory also owns the parsing helpers that read optional fields and validate the canonical binary layout before signature verification occurs.

field.name: SignatureAlgorithmRsaSha512Pss
field.summary: Internal signature algorithm discriminator for RSA-PSS SHA-512.

method.name: TryCreateArtifact
method.summary: Create a signed `DataFieldAssertion` artifact from canonical assertion data and a signer certificate.
method.param: Canonical assertion data to serialize and sign.
Certificate containing the RSA private key used to sign the canonical assertion data.
method.returns: True when the assertion was created successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryCreateBytes
method.summary: Create serialized signed assertion bytes from canonical assertion data and a signer certificate.
method.param: Canonical assertion data to serialize and sign.
Certificate containing the RSA private key used to sign the canonical assertion data.
method.returns: True when the assertion was created and serialized successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryReadArtifact
method.summary: Read serialized signed assertion bytes into a parsed `DataFieldAssertion` artifact without performing trust validation.
method.returns: True when the signed envelope and canonical data were parsed successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryReadParts
method.summary: Read serialized signed assertion bytes into canonical data and signature parts.
method.returns: True when the signed envelope and canonical data were parsed successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryWriteData
method.summary: Serialize canonical assertion data into its binary layout.
method.returns: True when serialization succeeded; otherwise false.

method.name: TryValidateData
method.summary: Validate the canonical assertion data to ensure it meets the necessary criteria for creating a valid assertion.
method.returns: True if the data is valid; otherwise, false.

method.name: BuildEnvelope
method.summary: Build the outer signed assertion envelope from canonical assertion data and signature bytes.

method.name: TryReadData
method.summary: Parse canonical assertion data from the serialized binary payload.
method.returns: True when the canonical assertion-data payload parsed successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryReadEnvelope
method.summary: Parse the outer signed assertion envelope into canonical data and signature spans.
method.returns: True when the outer signed assertion envelope parsed successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryReadByteArray
method.summary: Read a length-prefixed byte array from the canonical assertion-data reader.
method.returns: True when the byte array was read successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryReadOptionalDateTimeOffset
method.summary: Read an optional Unix-time value and convert it to `DateTimeOffset` when present.
method.param: True when the optional value is present in the payload.
method.returns: True when the optional value was read successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryReadOptionalGuid
method.summary: Read an optional Guid value when the presence marker indicates that one is available.
method.param: True when the optional Guid is present in the payload.
method.returns: True when the optional Guid was read successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryReadOptionalUtf8String
method.summary: Read an optional UTF-8 string when the presence marker indicates that one is available.
method.param: True when the optional string is present in the payload.
method.returns: True when the optional string was read successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryReadUtf8String
method.summary: Read a length-prefixed UTF-8 string from the canonical assertion-data reader.
method.returns: True when the string was read successfully; otherwise false.
